articles.title: Oura is delaying its IPO.
articles.summary:
In the works since earlier this year, plans to go public were only announced a week ago, but are already on the rocks. The smart ring company blames the postponement on “uncertainty in the IPO market,” and CEO Tom Hale suggests it will still go ahead eventually:
> “We aim to deliver an extraordinary IPO for our employees and investors and we have the luxury of choosing our moment.”
articles.body:

articles.title: Marshall shrinks its party speaker again.
articles.summary:
Following the 52-pound Bromley 750 that launched last year and the 27-pound Bromley 450 announced in March, the new 14-pound Bromley 150 is now the lightest and cheapest Bluetooth party speaker that Marshall makes, and it still features the array of white LED stage lights hidden behind its front speaker grill. You can preorder it from Marshall’s online store for $499.99 with shipping starting next month.
